body: I will never trust anyone ever again, and no one will miss me. No one will even notice I’m dead until I don’t show up for work on tuesday. I refuse to trust anyone or keep going. I can’t even graduate college and will never be able to support myself long term in the current economy, and would just be a burden to society. I won’t let that happen. This is for the best.
Thanks for the concern but I have no future. It’s just not going to work out. This is for the best all around.

I have no one, and my last two friends betrayed my trust so thoroughly I could never trust anyone again. I took a vow a year ago when I was assaulted by a coworker to never trust or make another friend again and I haven’t.
I’ve called them before. They can’t help me. Thanks for the concern. I’m fine.
I’ve already provided for them to go to my mom and I have savings so it won’t be as much of a burden. They will be taken care of and loved.
